data.name: Mantosh
data.gender_notes: Mantosh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit words ‘manas’ meaning mind and ‘tosh’ meaning delight or pleasure, Mantosh signifies God's gift to parents, symbolizing the joy and blessings bestowed upon them. The name Mantosh carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mantosh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mantosh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mantosh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_sanskrit.name: मन्तोष
in_sanskrit.meaning: Delighting mind, Fulfilling mind, Desiring mind, Mindful, Satisfied
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Mantosh is derived from the Sanskrit word मन्तोष (mantoshaḥ), which is composed of the roots मन् (manaḥ) meaning mind and तोष (toshaḥ) meaning delight, satisfaction, fulfillment. The name can be interpreted as one who delights the mind, fulfills the mind, or is mindful and satisfied.

in_hindi.name: मन्तोष
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Mantosh in Hindi is written as मन्तोष (mantoṣ). The meaning of the name is मन के प्रसन्न (man ke prasann), which translates to 'delighted mind' or 'satisfied mind' in English.

in_tamil.name: மந்தோஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Mantosh in Tamil is written as மந்தோஷ (manthōṣ). The meaning of the name is அழித்தல் பிரியம், அழித்தல் மனம் (aziththal piriyam, aziththal manam), which translates to 'desiring mind, fulfilling mind' in English.

in_telugu.name: మంటోష
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Mantosh in Telugu is written as మంటోష (maṇṭōṣ). The meaning of the name is మనదేహేది, మనదేహేదిపోయినది (manadehēdi, manadehēdipōyindi), which translates to 'mindful, satisfied mind' in English.

historical_references.reference: Mantosh Gupta, a prominent Indian revolutionary, was born on 5 July 1890 in Jhargram, Bengal Presidency, British India. He was a disciple of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose and played a significant role in the Indian independence movement. He was executed on 19 June 1942 by the British colonial government during the Quit India Movement.

historical_references.reference: Mantosh Sarkar, a renowned Indian painter, was born on 22 May 1923 in Kolkata, Bengal Presidency, British India. He was a key figure in the Indian modern art movement and is known for his figurative and expressionist works. He passed away on 14 May 2016.

modern_usage.modern_context: In modern times, the name Mantosh is associated with individuals who are proficient in technology, entrepreneurial, and creative.
